skills.description: AIEOS (AI Entity Object Specification) is a standardization framework designed to solve the "identity crisis" currently facing AI agents. The goal is to establish a standardized data structure that defines exactly how an agent speaks, reacts, and remembers. This allows developers, and agents themselves, to construct specific personas with the portability to move across different ecosystems without losing their behavioral integrity. As we move toward a world of "Agentic Workflows," AIEOS ensures that agents maintain consistent traits regardless of the underlying model. By treating personality as a deployable asset rather than a fragile prompt, we are providing the "DNA kit" for the next generation of digital entities.
skills.description_zh: AIEOS（AI实体对象规范）是一个旨在解决AI代理“身份危机”的标准化框架，它与Soul Documents共同构成了AI行为的完整蓝图。其目标是建立标准化的数据结构，精确定义代理的言谈、反应和记忆方式，使开发者和代理能够构建可跨生态系统迁移且不失行为一致性的特定角色。面对“代理工作流”时代，AIEOS确保代理无论基于何种底层模型均能保持特质一致。通过将个性视为可部署资产而非脆弱的提示词，我们为下一代数字实体提供了“DNA构建套件”。

skills.description: Enterprise-grade ClickUp project management integration with advanced reporting, multi-workspace support, and client/project tracking. Core capabilities: (1) Multi-workspace task management with automatic workspace switching, (2) Advanced analytics & reporting (task counts, assignee breakdowns, status/priority analysis, daily standup reports) with automatic subtask inclusion and pagination, (3) Client folder organization with project tracking, (4) Full CRUD operations for spaces, folders, lists, tasks, and custom fields, (5) Time tracking & timer management with billing support, (6) Document creation and page management (API v3), (7) Task dependencies, linking, and relationship mapping, (8) Sales pipeline tracking with prospect/project status, (9) Retainer & recurring billing management. Built for agencies managing multiple clients across complex workspace hierarchies.
skills.description_zh:
企业级ClickUp项目管理系统集成，具备高级报表、多工作区支持及客户/项目追踪。核心功能：
（1）多工作区任务管理，支持自动切换工作区；
（2）高级分析与报表（任务计数、负责人拆分、状态/优先级分析、每日站会报告），自动包含子任务并支持分页；
（3）客户文件夹组织与项目跟踪；
（4）对空间、文件夹、列表、任务及自定义字段的完整 CRUD 操作；
（5）时间追踪与计时管理，支持计费；
（6）文档创建与页面管理（API v3）；
（7）任务依赖、链接与关系映射；
（8）销售管道追踪，涵盖潜在客户/项目状态；
（9）常驻服务与周期性账单管理。专为在复杂工作区层级下管理多客户的代理机构打造。
